name: Electrified Water Ward

source.title: Pathfinder #170: Spoken on the Song Wind

disable: DC 26 Thievery check (expert), DC 28 Arcana check (expert), or DC 28 Occultism check (expert) to harmlessly bleed away the electrical energy from the rune. Once the trap has been activated, the electrical energy is stronger, so three successful checks (of any combination of the relevant skills) are necessary to deactivate it, but these checks can be attempted from anywhere in the room.
reset: The pulses stop as soon as no creatures are in the hallway, and then reset after 1 hour.
routine: (1 action) The trap deals 4d10 electricity damage (DC 26 basic Reflex save save) to all creatures in the room. A creature that fails the save is Slowed 1 (Slowed 2 on a critical failure). A creature that isn't touching the water treats the result of its saving throw as one degree of success better.

items.name: Electrocution
items.text:
Trigger A creature passes over the invisible underwater rune between the north and south doors

---

Effect The trap deals 4d10 electricity damage (DC 26 basic Reflex save save) to creatures touching the water, and then rolls initiative.

text: Passing over an invisible rune on the floor between the north and south doors triggers a dancing burst of electricity.
